gaps.explanation: Re-read p6 (Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Cash Basis - Proprietary Funds, columns Water / Sewer / Total): 'Operating transfers in (out)' prints '-' in Water, '-' in Sewer and (102,905) only in the Total column; 'Net operating transfers' likewise Water '-', Sewer '-', Total (102,905). The fund columns do not carry it (Water net income (209,420) + Sewer 218,175 = 8,755, Total (94,150): the report itself does not add up across columns by exactly this 102,905, 1 rounding). The only other place the amount is printed is the all-funds budgetary comparison schedule p7 ('Transfers in' Actual 102,905, 'Transfers out' (130,202), all funds of the primary government combined), which names no fund. business_type.transfers_net -102,905 comes from the p6 Total column. No fund column prints the amount, so no fund line can be added (Total column never used; no derived figures). No detail change.
